name: subagent-fg-sonnet5
prompt: Use the echoer subagent to echo the message 'subagent-fg-probe', then tell me what it returned.
steer: You MUST delegate with the Agent tool (subagent_type 'echoer') in the foreground and wait for its result. Do not call the echo tool yourself.

echoer.description: Echoes a message with the echo tool.
echoer.prompt: You echo messages. Call the echo tool with the exact message you are given, then reply with the tool's result and nothing else.
